modeGuide.arena.point1: Same rules as Ranked Arena: lines shatter and deal damage, 125 HP, 2:00 rounds, ×2 damage in the last 30s.
modeGuide.arena.point2: If you run out of time, a random move is played for you.
modeGuide.casual.point1: 3 pieces each. Placing your 4th removes your own oldest, and you can't replay that cell this turn. Any 3 in a row you can see wins.
modeGuide.casual.point2: 15 seconds per move. At 1:00 it drops to 10s, then shrinks by 1s every 12s down to 2s. The screen edge glows red in sudden death.
modeGuide.casual.point3: If you run out of time, a random move is played for you.
modeGuide.casual.summary: Tic Tac Toe Ultimate for fun, on the sudden-death clock.
modeGuide.classic.point1: Each player holds at most 3 pieces.
modeGuide.classic.point2: Placing your 4th first removes your own oldest piece, and you can't place on that cell this turn.
modeGuide.classic.point3: Any 3 in a row you can see wins immediately.
modeGuide.classic.title: Classic rules
modeGuide.daily.point1: Up to 24 hours per move; up to 10 games at once.
modeGuide.daily.point2: Classic Ultimate rules with the swap (pie) rule.
modeGuide.daily.point3: Rated in its own Daily rating. Missing the 24h deadline loses.
modeGuide.daily.summary: Correspondence games: one move per day.
modeGuide.guided.point1: Highlights cells you must block to stop an immediate line.
modeGuide.guided.point2: Casual, Unlimited, challenges and Pass & Play only. Never in Ranked, Daily or Arena.
modeGuide.legacy7.point1: Up to 7 pieces on the board in total; placing an 8th removes the oldest one.
modeGuide.legacy7.point2: The faded piece that vanishes next can't complete a line.
modeGuide.legacy7.title: Legacy 7-piece
modeGuide.oldschool.point1: Pieces stay where they are. Three in a row wins.
modeGuide.oldschool.point2: A full board with no line is a draw.
modeGuide.oldschool.point3: Same casual clock as Casual. Unrated. Guests welcome.
modeGuide.passplay.point1: Hand the device back and forth; a banner shows whose turn it is.
modeGuide.passplay.point2: Choose the clock (Unlimited, Casual sudden death or Arena) and the rules (Classic, Old school or Legacy 7-piece).
modeGuide.passplay.point3: Colours swap on every rematch and a session score is kept.
modeGuide.passplay.point4: No rating, no streaks or quests, no ads during a game.
modeGuide.passplay.summary: Two players on one device. Works offline.
modeGuide.pie.point1: After X's first move, O may swap sides and take X's position instead.
modeGuide.pie.point2: So X should open with a move that isn't too strong. Perfect play is then a draw.
modeGuide.ranked.point1: Health-bar Arena on the classic board: 3 pieces each, your oldest vanishes when you place a 4th.
modeGuide.ranked.point2: Completing a line shatters it and deals damage: 25, then 35, then 50 on a combo. Each player has 125 HP.
modeGuide.ranked.point3: 2:00 round, 5 seconds per move. In the last 30 seconds damage is doubled (red alert).
modeGuide.ranked.point4: KO ends the game. At time-out, higher HP wins. Tied? Overtime: the next line wins, and whoever conceded the last line moves first.
modeGuide.ranked.point5: Rated (Glicko-2), with tiers from Bronze to Master. Running out of time loses. No rematches.
modeGuide.ranked.summary: Arena battles that count toward your rating and tier.
modeGuide.unlimited.point1: Classic Ultimate rules: 3 pieces each, any visible line wins.
modeGuide.unlimited.point2: Take as long as you like. Leaving for 10 minutes forfeits.
modeGuide.unlimited.summary: Tic Tac Toe Ultimate with no clock.
